title: UAP Navy Encounters | Patrick "PJ" Hughes
description:
Patrick "PJ" Hughes recounts a TicTac UAP close-encounter by an E-2C Hawkeye aircraft during the 2004 Nimitz UAP incident, describes hard-drives being confiscated by USAF couriers soon after the Hawkeye landed, and discusses his role as an Aviation Electronics Technician on the Nimitz.

Patrick "PJ" Hughes served in the Navy as an Aviation Electronics Technician primarily on the E-2C Hawkeye and C-2A Greyhound airframes. 

In November 2004, Patrick was a Second Class Petty Officer attached to VAW-117 - the Carrier Airborne Early Warning Squadron - and was with the squadron onboard the Nimitz conducting Air Wing and Battlegroup exercises during the infamous UAP encounters that have made headlines worldwide.
